purpose: Decode and encode a versioned telemetry wire format.
consumers: Public Rust applications and protocol inspection tools.
lifecycle: Maintained public library with backward-compatible releases.
profile_rationale: Public API, hostile wire input, and measured decoding paths.

decisions.compatibility:
# Compatibility

Stable Rust; MSRV and SemVer are declared in repository configuration.
decisions.protocol:
# Protocol

Strict construction, finite parser budgets, and independent known-answer vectors are required.
decisions.testing:
# Testing

Unit, integration, doctest, boundary, property, and protocol vector tests are required.

prerequisites: Repository-pinned Rust toolchain with rustfmt component
Any native libraries documented by the repository

validation.description: Run Miri when the component and toolchain support it.
prerequisites: Nightly-compatible toolchain with the Miri component
validation.reason: No unsafe code is currently permitted.

unresolved: Confirm the sustained fuzzing cadence before the first public release.
